description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Prices the cart, tries payment processors until one accepts (the last one always does) and issues a receipt. Uses only system tasks, so no worker has to be running. If it fails or times out, chaos_checkout_rescue issues an emergency receipt instead.
name: chaos_checkout

tasks.loopCondition: (function(){ var i = $.payment_attempts['iteration']; var last = $.payment_attempts[String(i)]; var approved = !!(last && last.attempt_payment && last.attempt_payment.result && last.attempt_payment.result.approved); return !approved && i < 5; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression:
(.attempt | if type == "number" and . >= 1 then floor else 1 end) as $i
| (.cart.seed // 0) as $seed
| ($seed % 3 + 2) as $acceptAt
| [
    (.cart.payment.label // "A firm handshake"),
    "Fax-Based Payment Gateway",
    "A Guy Named Dale",
    "Carrier-Pigeon Wire Transfer",
    "IOU Written on a Napkin"
  ] as $processors
| [
    "Declined: the card felt nervous.",
    "Declined: insufficient vibes.",
    "Timed out while the gateway finished its sandwich.",
    "Declined: the processor is on hold with itself.",
    "Declined: Mercury is in retrograde.",
    "Declined: we forgot what we were doing.",
    "Declined: the fax machine is out of toner again."
  ] as $declines
| ($i >= $acceptAt or $i >= 5) as $approved
| {
    attempt: $i,
    processor: ($processors[(if $i > 5 then 5 else $i end) - 1]),
    approved: $approved,
    message: (if $approved
      then "Approved. Nobody is more surprised than we are."
      else $declines[($seed + $i) % ($declines | length)] end)
  }

tasks.name: payment_attempts

inputParameters.queryExpression:
[
  (.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
  | to_entries[]
  | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$"))
  | {n: (.key | tonumber), a: (.value.attempt_payment.result? // null)}
  | select(.a != null)
]
| sort_by(.n)
| map(.a) as $attempts
| ($attempts | map(select(.approved == true)) | last) as $winner
| {
    attempts: $attempts,
    attemptsNeeded: ($attempts | length),
    settled: true,
    settledBy: ($winner.processor // "House IOU (issued automatically)")
  }

.cart as $c
| [
    "Allocated. We think.",
    "Allocated to someone else, but we're working on it.",
    "Substituted with a similar item (a brick).",
    "Backordered until morale improves.",
    "In stock, location unknown."
  ] as $notes
| {
    lines: [
      $c.lines | to_entries[]
      | .value + {fulfilment: $notes[($c.seed + .key) % ($notes | length)]}
    ],
    trackingNumber: "TRK-\($c.seed)-LOST",
    carrier: $c.shipping.label,
    eta: $c.shipping.eta
  }

.cart as $c
| .pricing as $p
| (.fulfilment | if type == "object" and (.lines | type) == "array" then . else null end) as $f
| {
    status: "CONFIRMED",
    rescued: false,
    orderId: $c.orderId,
    placedAt: $c.placedAt,
    customer: $c.customer,
    lines: ($f.lines // [$c.lines[] | . + {fulfilment: "Status unavailable. Assume the worst."}]),
    itemCount: $p.itemCount,
    subtotalCents: $p.subtotalCents,
    charges: $p.charges,
    totalCents: $p.totalCents,
    coupon: $c.coupon,
    payment: (.payment + {method: $c.payment.label}),
    shipping: {
      method: $c.shipping.label,
      eta: $c.shipping.eta,
      trackingNumber: ($f.trackingNumber // "TRK-PENDING-LOST")
    },
    loyaltyPoints: (0 - (($p.totalCents / 100 | floor) % 1000000000000000)),
    message: "Thank you for your purchase. No further questions, please."
  }

description: Safety net for chaos_checkout. Conductor starts it as the failureWorkflow when a checkout fails or times out, and the store backend starts it when a checkout was terminated. It issues an emergency receipt at cost, so the order is still confirmed.
name: chaos_checkout_rescue

inputParameters.queryExpression:
.cart as $c
| ([$c.lines[] | .qty * .unitPriceCents] | add // 0) as $subtotal
| (.failure | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $x
| {
    status: "CONFIRMED",
    rescued: true,
    rescuedFrom: {
      workflowId: ($x.workflowId | if type == "string" then . else null end),
      reason: ($x.reason | if type == "string" then .[0:300] else "The checkout stopped before it finished." end)
    },
    orderId: $c.orderId,
    placedAt: $c.placedAt,
    customer: $c.customer,
    lines: [$c.lines[] | . + {fulfilment: "Allocated by hand, by whoever was nearest."}],
    itemCount: ([$c.lines[].qty] | add // 0),
    subtotalCents: $subtotal,
    charges: [
      {label: "Fees", amountCents: 0, note: "Waived. Our checkout fell over, so this one is at cost."}
    ],
    totalCents: $subtotal,
    coupon: $c.coupon,
    payment: {
      attempts: [],
      attemptsNeeded: 0,
      settled: true,
      settledBy: "House IOU (emergency edition)",
      method: $c.payment.label
    },
    shipping: {
      method: $c.shipping.label,
      eta: $c.shipping.eta,
      trackingNumber: "TRK-\($c.seed)-RESCUED"
    },
    loyaltyPoints: 0,
    message: "Our checkout fell over, so we finished your order by hand. It still counts."
  }

description: Chaos Commerce returns. Runs six pointless checks with a pause after each, waits a bounded time for the customer's Returns Oath, then decides: refund, store credit or denial. The oath wait ends by itself, so an abandoned return is still decided. Uses only system tasks. If it fails or times out, chaos_returns_default_decision approves the return by default.
name: chaos_returns

inputParameters.queryExpression:
def squash: ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z]"; "");

. as $in
| $in.ret as $r
| [
    ($in.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
    | to_entries[]
    | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$"))
    | {n: (.key | tonumber), c: (.value.run_check.result? // null)}
    | select(.c != null)
  ]
| sort_by(.n)
| map(.c) as $checks
| ($in.oath | if type == "object" then .oath else null end
    | if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:300] else null end) as $oath
| ($oath != null) as $received
| ($received and (($oath | squash) == ($r.oathText | squash))) as $exact
| ($r.seed % 10) as $roll
| {
    code: (if ($received | not) then "DENIED"
           elif $roll <= 4 then "APPROVED_REFUND"
           elif $roll <= 7 then "STORE_CREDIT"
           else "DENIED" end),
    denialGround: (if ($received | not) then "NO_OATH" else "POLICY" end),
    oath: {received: $received, exact: $exact, text: $oath},
    checks: $checks,
    checksRun: ($checks | length),
    checksPassed: ($checks | map(select(.verdict | startswith("PASS"))) | length),
    checksConsulted: 0
  }

.ret as $r
| $r.item.priceCents as $price
| [
    {label: "Item price", amountCents: $price},
    {label: "Restocking Fee (15%)", amountCents: (0 - (($price * 15 / 100 | ceil) % 1000000000000000))},
    {label: "Oath Processing Fee", amountCents: -199},
    {label: "Refund Refund Fee", amountCents: -99}
  ] as $lines
| ([$lines[].amountCents] | add) as $net
| (if $net < 1 then 1 else $net end) as $refund
| {
    refundCents: $refund,
    breakdown: (if $net < 1
      then $lines + [{label: "Goodwill Top-Up (refunds may not be negative)", amountCents: ($refund - $net)}]
      else $lines end),
    paidTo: "your original payment method, or the nearest one we can find"
  }

.ret as $r
| [
    "The item was returned in a condition best described as \"returned\".",
    "Our records show you enjoyed the item for at least four seconds.",
    "The return window closed before the item was manufactured.",
    "Returns are only accepted on days that do not end in \"y\".",
    "The box was happier with you."
  ] as $grounds
| {
    ground: (if .verdict.denialGround == "NO_OATH"
      then "No Returns Oath was on file when the \($r.oathWindowSeconds)-second oath window closed, so the return was decided without you."
      else $grounds[$r.seed % ($grounds | length)] end),
    appeal: "You may appeal in writing. Appeals are filed under \"Returns\"."
  }

.ret as $r
| .verdict as $v
| (.refund | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $refund
| (.credit | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $credit
| (.denial | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $denial
| (if $v.code == "APPROVED_REFUND" and $refund != null then "APPROVED_REFUND"
   elif $v.code == "DENIED" and $denial != null then "DENIED"
   else "STORE_CREDIT" end) as $code
| {
    status: "DECIDED",
    decidedByDefault: false,
    code: $code,
    returnId: $r.returnId,
    orderId: $r.orderId,
    orderFound: $r.orderFound,
    filedAt: $r.filedAt,
    customerName: $r.customerName,
    item: $r.item,
    reason: $r.reason,
    headline: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then "Return approved. A refund is, technically, on its way."
               elif $code == "DENIED" then "Return denied."
               else "Return approved for store credit." end),
    explanation: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then "Against all odds your return was approved. Your refund has been calculated below, fees included."
                  elif $code == "DENIED" then $denial.ground
                  else "We would rather not part with actual money, so please enjoy this store credit instead." end),
    refund: (if $code == "APPROVED_REFUND" then $refund else null end),
    credit: (if $code == "STORE_CREDIT"
      then ($credit // {
        creditCents: $r.item.priceCents,
        creditCode: "SORRY-\($r.seed)",
        terms: "Worth the item price. Valid until we notice."
      })
      else null end),
    denial: (if $code == "DENIED" then $denial else null end),
    oath: $v.oath,
    checks: $v.checks,
    checksRun: $v.checksRun,
    checksPassed: $v.checksPassed,
    checksConsulted: 0,
    footnote: "\($v.checksRun) checks were run. \($v.checksPassed) passed. 0 were consulted in reaching this decision."
  }

description: Safety net for chaos_returns. Conductor starts it as the failureWorkflow when a return fails or times out, and the store backend starts it when a return was terminated. It approves the return by default, so every return still gets a decision.
name: chaos_returns_default_decision

inputParameters.queryExpression:
.ret as $r
| (.failure | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $x
| {
    status: "DECIDED",
    decidedByDefault: true,
    decidedInsteadOf: {
      workflowId: ($x.workflowId | if type == "string" then . else null end),
      reason: ($x.reason | if type == "string" then .[0:300] else "The returns process stopped before it finished." end)
    },
    code: "APPROVED_BY_DEFAULT",
    returnId: $r.returnId,
    orderId: $r.orderId,
    orderFound: $r.orderFound,
    filedAt: $r.filedAt,
    customerName: $r.customerName,
    item: $r.item,
    reason: $r.reason,
    headline: "Return approved by default.",
    explanation: "Our returns department fell over while handling your return. Under Policy 0 (\"if we break it, you win\") the return is approved in full, with no fees.",
    refund: {
      refundCents: $r.item.priceCents,
      breakdown: [{label: "Item price", amountCents: $r.item.priceCents}],
      paidTo: "your original payment method, or the nearest one we can find"
    },
    credit: null,
    denial: null,
    oath: {received: false, exact: false, text: null},
    checks: [],
    checksRun: 0,
    checksPassed: 0,
    checksConsulted: 0,
    footnote: "0 checks were consulted in reaching this decision, which is the usual number."
  }
